Feb. Jermie Hughes - infected eye - fears operation Mrs. C. Rose - Chatam - 70 in May - threatened cancer Feb. 14 Ellen Roy - 26 = 3 yrs T.B. asks for prayers Albert Beyer - 23 - hard breathing spells - caused by defective nerves.
Helen Samp - 34 - breast - cancer, fears open
Thomas Menion - after three blood transfusions ... O.K.
Geo. Murphy - found dead in alley - leaves wife and two small ch. took pledge 1 yr. ago - made Easter but not since.
Cath. Audley - Escaped from accident. - 2 hind wheels taken com- pletely off.
Patrick McCarthy - 33 - sore lip .... Mr. Herman - 37 - architect .... NewP.O ...... Mr. & Mrs. Zens Case - Chicago - to Pat. Doran - cancer of throat

Page 91 Page 92 Feb. Myrtle Bradey - 38 - Milwaukee - cancer Agnes Hann - 45 - cancer stomach Mrs. Helen Egan - 32 - Fears operation for inner goiter - rhumatism Edw'd Cikorski - 21 - rhumatic - weak feet & legs Phil Marlow - 37 - stroke on Labor day - speechless. . ... from over lifting.
Isabel Health - 28 - invalid since August - spinal trouble & paral- ysis
J. Rom. Ryan - 45 - Drinking.
